description: The realm's phase machine: intake frames, a contrarian design panel argues before any code, implement builds, hermetic gates verify, a four-member review panel judges (correctness, security, guarantees and tests, decision 0013; the protected phase), ship records the ledger. Design and review are model seats; verify, ship and the design check are deterministic exec drivers — the hybrid. security-hold is a hard stop, security residuals never take the tracked-debt path. A residual above low, or any security residual, returns to implement with the findings; the sixth review that still holds one parks for the operator (decision 0102).

rules.reason: Task framed and recorded; the panel argues before any code is written.
Spec committed and structurally validated by the deterministic check (the sequence's final exec step, scripts/design-check.sh from the pinned bundle); only its 'designed' advances.

'drafted' is the chief's intermediate step result; the deterministic check's verdict is the phase result. A phase-level 'drafted' means the check did not rule, so it never advances (decision 0050 §3).
Two consecutive failed design validations; stop rather than thrash.
First failed design validation; one re-run permitted.
Two consecutive broken implement runs; stop rather than thrash.
First broken run; one re-run permitted.
Implementer blocked; report, never silently continue.
Implementation complete and committed.
Verification failed; not shippable.
Suite green; reviewers read verified code.
Unresolved security findings. NEVER ship; risk acceptance is the operator's.
Five rework rounds spent and a residual above low remains: the operator rules on it (decision 0102). A park is no clearance; nothing ships.
Five rework rounds spent and a security residual remains: risk acceptance is the operator's (decision 0102).
A medium or higher residual returns to implement with the panel's findings, at most five times (decision 0102).
A security residual never takes the tracked-debt path; it returns to implement, at most five times (decision 0102).
Explicitly non-security residuals of an explicit severity at or below low proceed as tracked debt (decision 0102).
Low residuals with fixes applied re-verify before shipping.

Security residuals never take the tracked-debt path, and residual safety facts absent, null or malformed are unknown, never shippable: nothing is defaulted or inferred (decision 0050 §4). One rule holds both because the engine refuses an unknown-only stop as dead behind a security rule — with every fact present, the rules above it already decide.
Clean with no code changed; verification evidence stands.
Clean but fixes applied; re-verify before shipping.
Missing, malformed or inconsistent scope/fixes facts cannot authorize shipping or reverification (0057). Explicit scope defects require reframing.
HEAD moved after review; re-arm a scoped review.
Dirty tree at ship time is a defect.
Gates passed and ledger written; confirm close-out and report shipped.
HEAD moved between ready and close-out; re-arm a scoped review.
A dirty worktree at close-out is a defect.
Close-out confirmed. The operator pushes and merges.
